task.title: Read the wiki
task.body:
Pages exactly as the desktop shows them. See [[Experience#wiki]].

- [ ] Page tree drawer, breadcrumb, home page first
- [ ] Page body in the kit with a real `MarkdownContext`; images and embeds served through checked paths
- [ ] Tapping references opens tasks, pages and files; red references offer a new page (wired up in [[GM-16]])
- [ ] **On this page** sheet; pinch to zoom diagrams and images
- [ ] Opens in under a second for Genbeya's own wiki on a mid-range phone
- [ ] Completions for `[[`, `@` and `//` inside the kit, from its context ([[Kit build]])
